Moments later, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is summoned by <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>...
PunishEvent1_13.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被押至伏龙坛海岛内，
此处遍地焦石，海天赤红……

看守弟子见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被押解至此，便即前往通报，
片刻方回，称<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>要面见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

PunishEvent1_14.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought to the Sanguine Sect's valley,
where bones lie scattered and the skies echo with the cries of crows and vultures...

The guarding disciple, upon seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> escorted in, immediately reports it.
Moments later, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is summoned by <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>...
PunishEvent1_14.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被押至血犼教山谷内，
此处血海骨丘，乌啼鸱鸣……

看守弟子见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被押解至此，便即前往通报，
片刻方回，称<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>要面见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

PunishEvent2_0.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of the Shaolin Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who bows before speaking softly:

"In these troubled times, our Shaolin Sect must uphold justice.
Your wrongdoings in the Jingji region cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_0.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此少林寺大殿，
将至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，其略施一礼，缓声道：

“当此乱世，我少林自当主持公道，
你既在京畿之地犯错，便须依律受惩……”

PunishEvent2_1.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of the Emei Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who bows before speaking softly:

"In these chaotic times, we must do all we can to protect the people...
Your wrongdoings in Shu cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_1.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此峨嵋派大殿内，
将至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，其略施一礼，缓声道：

“此世道乱象频生，我等须尽力护百姓安危……
你既在蜀地犯下过错，需得依律惩处……”

PunishEvent2_2.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the loft of the Valley of Flowers,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who declares:

"Taiwu is meant to embrace the spirit of selflessness.
Yet, you have violated our code. Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_2.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此百花谷阁楼中，
 将至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听其朗声道：

 “太吾本应与我等一般舍己救人，怀济世之心，
然而，如今你既犯下过错，还请依律受罚……”

PunishEvent2_3.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of the Wudang Sect.
Upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who declares:

"The world is in turmoil, the people suffer. It is our duty to uphold justice...
Yet, you have violated our code. Your wrongdoings in Jingbei cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_3.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此武当派大殿内，
 及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方开口道：

 “如今天下纷扰，百姓难安，我等自当为其主持公道……
你既在荆北之地犯下过错，便须依律受罚……”

PunishEvent2_4.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of the Yuanshan Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who speaks in a resolute tone:

"This world is overrun with demons, and the people suffer. It is our duty to sacrifice for righteousness and protect the innocent!
Yet, you have violated our code. Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_4.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此元山派大殿内，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，方听对方正声道：

 “此乱世妖魔并起，百姓罹难，我等自当舍身取义，覆护黎民！
 你犯下过错，不容轻赦，须得依律惩处……”

PunishEvent2_5.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of Lion-Face Clan,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who exclaims:

"Daring to stir trouble on my Guangdong turf—are you looking down on the brothers of Lion-Face Clan?!
Weak in body, corrupt in heart—looks like you need some proper training in our sect!"
PunishEvent2_5.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此狮相门大堂内，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方高声道：

 “敢在我广东地界犯事，阁下莫非是瞧不起我狮相门各堂弟兄？！
 身不强，则心不正，就让你在我门中好好操练一番！”

PunishEvent2_6.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the loft of the Ranshan Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who declares:

"The laws of heaven and earth must be upheld.
We seldom interfere with worldly affairs, yet since you have disturbed our Qilu lands,
you cannot be allowed to leave unpunished—prepare to face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_6.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此然山派阁楼中，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方开口道：

 “天地之间，自有法理相循，
 我等虽甚少问及尘世，然你既扰我齐鲁之地，
 便难以轻纵，还请依律受罚……”

PunishEvent2_7.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of the Jade-Maiden Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who says:

"Our sect does not meddle in worldly affairs lightly,
yet, the people of Jingnan have long been under our care.
Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent2_7.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此璇女派楼阁中，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，方听对方开口道：

 “尘世俗务，我等本无意过多牵涉，
然荆南之百姓，素来与我派互有照拂，
 你既犯下过错，须得依律受惩……”

PunishEvent2_8.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the Foundry Houses of the Swordsmith Villa,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who says:

"Though we forge weapons, we also safeguard this land and its people.
Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment. There is nothing more to say..."
PunishEvent2_8.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此铸剑山庄之铸造坊中，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方开口道：

 “我等虽以铸造宝剑为要，但亦护佑此地百姓安危，
你既已服法，也无须再多言，便请依律受惩……”

PunishEvent2_9.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the Alchemy Lab of the Kongsang Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who declares:

"Though we seek the path to immortality and wish not to be disturbed by trivial matters,
this place is our sanctuary, and we will not allow any disruption..."
PunishEvent2_9.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此空桑派药房中， 
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方朗声道：

 “我等虽一心求取长生之道，不愿为旁杂之事所扰， 
但此地毕竟是我等的安身之处，不容有人打搅……”

PunishEvent2_10.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of Vajra Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, who says in a solemn tone:

"All Western Regions bow to our sect's glory.
Your transgression tarnishes the Buddha's name—you shall be chastised..."
PunishEvent2_10.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此金刚宗大殿内，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方沉声道：

“西域之地皆供奉我金刚宗，
你在此处犯错，便是坏了佛爷威名，须得惩治一番……”

PunishEvent2_11.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the stronghold of Five Immortals Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, whose voice booms:

"Our Gu have almost starved in their crucibles...
You'll serve as their feeding trough before leaving..."
PunishEvent2_11.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此五仙教寨中，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方扬声道：

“寨中的毒蛊虫豸，已炼了许久，正须试验毒性，
你既落在我五仙教手中，便得给你种只蛊儿才能让你离去……”

PunishEvent2_12.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the cavern of Veil Scar Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, whose voice echoes:

"The JVeil Scar Sect needs no reasons—only obedience.
You are ours to break..."
PunishEvent2_12.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此界青门崖窟内，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方开口道：

“界青门有界青门的规矩，
我界青门要惩治你，你便无须知道其中的缘故……”
PunishEvent2_12.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> входит в пещеру Секты Завесы, после чего достигает <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, чей голос вторит эхом:\n\n "Секте Джвейл Шрам не нужны никакие причины — только повиновение."Ты наш, чтобы сломить..."

PunishEvent2_13.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of Fuloong Sanctuary,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, whose voice echoes through the chamber:

"The Chiming Island's people offer us gold and silver in tribute, blessed under the True Loong's protection.
Yet you dare undermine its divine authority? You shall face severe punishment!"
PunishEvent2_13.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此伏龙坛大殿，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方高声道：

“赤明岛内百姓皆向我派供奉金银，便是得了真龙护佑，
你却在此处破坏我等神威，须得严惩！”

PunishEvent2_14.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the grand hall of Sanguine Sect,
upon reaching <Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>, whose voice rings out:

"Dare you act with such insolence within the domain of the Sanguine Sect?
Do you not tremble before the wrath of Xiangshu the Great Lord? Should I fail to punish you, it would tarnish the honor of our entire sect..."
PunishEvent2_14.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入此血犼教大殿，
及至<Character key=SectLeader str=Name/>身前，便听对方高声道：

“你在我血犼神教的地界上为所欲为，
岂不让相枢大神小瞧了我等，若不将你惩治，有损我教声威……”

PunishEvent3_0.en:
The punishment of the Shaolin Sect requires
that the coffender listen to the Buddha's teachings, turn their heart toward Buddhism,
and, with the intent to sever all worldly attachments,
let every bond of mortal affection eventually fade into oblivion...
PunishEvent3_0.cn:
少林派所设惩戒，
需受惩者聆听佛法，心向空门，
有意断绝尘世恩怨，渐而其所结尘缘之人，
皆化为陌路……

PunishEvent3_1.en: The punishment of the Emei Sect ensures that, for months to come,\nthe Bashu people regard the punished with trepidation,\nAs such, they can no longer seek Martial Arts or Fine Arts guidance from the people of Shu...
PunishEvent3_1.cn: 峨眉派所设惩戒，乃是此后诸月，\n巴蜀人士皆对受惩者有所忌惮，\n是故其无法向蜀地人士请教武学与技艺……
PunishEvent3_1.ru: Наказание Секты Эмэй гарантирует, что в течение последующих месяцев народ Башу будет относиться к наказанным с трепетом, поэтому они больше не могут обращаться за руководством к Боевым искусствам или Ремеслам изобразительного искусства от народа Шу...

PunishEvent3_2.en: The punishment of the Valley of Flowers is:\nto seal the offender's meridians with golden needles, quelling all Qi,\nand for months thereafter, no recovery is possible...
PunishEvent3_2.cn: 百花派所设惩戒，\n乃是用金针封住受惩者周身经脉，消弭其所有内力真气，\n此后诸月，亦难以复原……
PunishEvent3_2.ru: Наказание Долины цветов таково: Печать меридианов нарушителя золотыми иглами подавляет всю Ци, и в течение нескольких месяцев после этого выздоровление невозможно...

PunishEvent3_3.en: The punishment of the Wudang Sect requires\nthe offender to shut themselves away in solitude, forsaking food and water.\nTheir pulses grow flawed, and their Inner Breath become chaotic for months...
PunishEvent3_3.cn: 武当派所设惩戒，\n受惩者需闭门苦思，断绝饮食，\n然脉象虚浮，三焦阻逆，此后诸月内息紊乱，难以调和……
PunishEvent3_3.ru: Наказание Секты Удан требует, чтобы преступник заперся в одиночестве, отказавшись от Еды и воды.\Их пульс становится неровным, а Внутреннее дыхание на месяцы становится хаотичным...

PunishEvent3_4.en: The punishment of the Yuanshan Sect,\nplaces the offender in a stone cell, forcing them to witness the madness of the Bewitched.\nTheir mind is disturbed, their heart weighed down with sorrow...
PunishEvent3_4.cn: 元山派所设惩戒，\n乃是将受惩者置于石牢中，使其亲历失心人之惨状，\n然心生魔障，郁郁寡欢……
PunishEvent3_4.ru: Наказание Секты Юаньшань заключает преступника в каменную камеру, заставляя его стать свидетелем безумия заколдованных.Их разум встревожен, их сердце отягощено печалью...

PunishEvent3_5.en: The punishment of the Lion-Face Clan\ninvolves constant, relentless training, pushing the offender to the point of exhaustion.\nIn time, their skills will fade, and their Talent will be permanently stunted...
PunishEvent3_5.cn: 狮相门所设惩戒，\n乃是让受惩者终日操练，乏累至极，\n便会诸艺荒废，资质受挫……
PunishEvent3_5.ru: Наказание клана Львинолицых предполагает постоянные, неустанные тренировки, доводящие нарушителя до изнеможения.\Со временем их навыки угаснут, а их Талант будет постоянно подавляться...

PunishEvent3_6.en: The punishment of the Ranshan Sect plunges the offender into the deepest meditative trance.\nUpon returning, they feel a void within, their energy drained and their Qi dissipated,\ntheir Pure Essence lost for months to come...
PunishEvent3_6.cn: 然山派所设惩戒，乃是让受惩者神入玄冥，\n其归来之后便感身心空荡，体内虚乏枯竭，\n此后诸月精纯尽失……
PunishEvent3_6.ru: Наказание Секты Жаньшань погружает преступника в глубочайший медитативный транс.Возвращаясь, они чувствуют пустоту внутри, их Энергия истощена, а Ци рассеяна, их Чистая эссенция утрачена на долгие месяцы...

PunishEvent3_7.en: The punishment of the Jade-Maiden Sect requires\nthe offender to endure sorrowful melodies that pierce the mind.\nThey must listen unceasingly, their thoughts unraveling, their spirit fading, until even their Dispositions are diminished...
PunishEvent3_7.cn: 璇女派所设惩戒，\n受惩者需终日聆听凄然之乐，此乐声摧人心智，\n使听者神魂恍惚，以至呆若木鸡，情性尽失，七元赋性渐次衰减……
PunishEvent3_7.ru: Наказание Секты Девы Нефрита требует от преступника терпеть печальные мелодии, которые пронзают разум.\Они должны слушать непрестанно, их мысли путаются, их Дух угасает, пока даже их Расположение не ослабеет...

PunishEvent3_8.en: The punishment of the Swordsmith Villa forces\nthe offender to work tirelessly beside the furnace,\nenduring searing heat and smothering smoke until their body withers from the ordeal...
PunishEvent3_8.cn: 铸剑山庄所设惩戒，\n乃是将受惩者置于锻炉旁，\n让其终日劳作，经受烟熏火燎，致使其形貌衰颓……
PunishEvent3_8.ru: Наказание в Усадьбе ковких мечей заставляет преступника неустанно трудиться у печи, терпя обжигающий жар и удушающий дым, пока его тело не иссохнет от этого испытания...

PunishEvent3_9.en: The punishment of the Kongsang Sect is to\nforce the offender to ingest a variety of deadly poisons.\nTheir effects are unpredictable, and the danger they pose is extreme, with the symptoms being as deadly as they are unknown...
PunishEvent3_9.cn: 空桑派所设惩戒，\n受惩者需以身试药，服下多种奇毒，\n其毒性相异，发作后症候难料，凶险异常……
PunishEvent3_9.ru: Наказание Секты Кунсан заключается в том, чтобы заставить преступника проглотить различные смертельные яды.\Их последствия непредсказуемы, и опасность, которую они представляют, чрезвычайно велика, а симптомы столь же смертельны, сколь и неизвестны...

PunishEvent3_10.en: The punishment of the Vajra Sect\nuses secret skills to create illusions, forcing the offender to face the terrifying images of Rakshasa demons, and suffer from the three poisons,\nuntil their Meridians and Chakras rupture and spiritual essence crumbles...
PunishEvent3_10.cn: 金刚宗所设惩戒，乃是以秘法加身，\n令受惩者见罗刹恶鬼之姿，受三毒无量之苦，\n致使其三脉七轮失常，诸性受损……

PunishEvent3_11.en: The punishment of the Five Immortals Sect\ninvolves channeling Gu into the offender's body.\nThey endure its gnawing day and night—a feast for worms, a warning to fools...
PunishEvent3_11.cn: 五仙教所设惩戒，\n乃是于受惩者体内种下蛊虫， \n此后受惩者将终日受蛊虫噬咬，苦不堪言……
PunishEvent3_11.ru: Наказание Секты пяти Бессмертных включает в себя введение Гу в тело преступника.Они терпят его грызение день и ночь — пиршество для червей, предостережение глупцам...

PunishEvent3_12.en: The punishment of the Veil Scar Sect is\nto throw the offender's name-sealed token into the Demise Abyss,\nand for the next several months, anyone who finds it will relentlessly hunt them down...
PunishEvent3_12.cn: 界青门所设惩戒，\n乃是将刻有受惩者姓名的密令投入无生渊下，\n此后诸月，拾此令牌者将持续对其进行追杀……
PunishEvent3_12.ru: Наказание Секты Завесы состоит в том, чтобы бросить жетон с Печатью имени преступника в Бездну Гибели, и в течение следующих нескольких месяцев любой, кто найдет его, будет безжалостно выслеживать его...

PunishEvent3_13.en: The punishment of the Fuloong Sanctuary requires the offender to be placed beside searing lava,\nenduring the flames as they burn their flesh. The air around them is thick with heat.\nThe scorching heat alone is enough to ignite their very soul, and the burns inflicted are wounds that never heal...
PunishEvent3_13.cn: 伏龙坛所设惩戒，需于滚沸熔岩旁，\n引火山烈焰加以焚炙，此间蒸腾之气使受惩者五内俱焚，\n炽痛难忍，且烧灼之伤不易愈合……

PunishEvent3_14.en: The punishment of the Sanguine Sect\ninvolves submerging the offender in the Blood Pool,followed by cruel torture.\nWounds would fester and rot, the pain gnawing deep into their very bones...
PunishEvent3_14.cn: 血犼教所设惩戒，\n乃是将受惩者投入血池，后施以酷刑，\n受惩者伤处溃烂，常有痛入骨髓之感……
PunishEvent3_14.ru: Наказание Багряной секты включает погружение преступника в лужу крови с последующими жестокими пытками.Раны гноились бы и гнили, боль вгрызалась бы глубоко в их кости...

PunishEvent4_0.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Shaolin senior who guards here.
The senior bows before speaking softly:

"In these troubled times, our Shaolin Sect must uphold justice.
Your wrongdoings in the Jingji region cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_0.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至少林派护卫此地的前辈身前，
其略施一礼，缓声道：

“当此乱世，我少林自当主持公道，
你既在京畿之地犯错，便须依律受惩……”

PunishEvent4_1.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Emei senior who guards here.
The senior bows before speaking softly:

"In these chaotic times, we must do all we can to protect the people...
Your wrongdoings in Shu cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_1.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至峨眉派护卫此地的前辈身前，
其略施一礼，缓声道：

“此世道乱象频生，我等须尽力护百姓安危……
你既在蜀地犯下过错，需得依律惩处……”

PunishEvent4_2.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Valley of Flowers senior who guards here.
The senior declares:

"Taiwu is meant to embrace the spirit of selflessness.
Yet, you have violated our code. Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_2.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至百花谷护卫此地的前辈身前，
便听其朗声道：

 “太吾本应与我等一般舍己救人，怀济世之心，
然而，如今你既犯下过错，还请依律受罚……”

PunishEvent4_3.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Wudang Sect senior who guards here.
The senior declares:

"The world is in turmoil, the people suffer. It is our duty to uphold justice...
Yet, you have violated our code. Your wrongdoings in Jingbei cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_3.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至武当派护卫此地的前辈身前，
便听对方开口道：

 “如今天下纷扰，百姓难安，我等自当为其主持公道……
你既在荆北之地犯下过错，便须依律受罚……”

PunishEvent4_4.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Yuanshan senior who guards here.
The senior speaks in a resolute tone:

"This world is overrun with demons, and the people suffer. It is our duty to sacrifice for righteousness and protect the innocent!
Yet, you have violated our code. Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_4.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至元山派护卫此地的前辈身前，
方听对方正声道：

 “此乱世妖魔并起，百姓罹难，我等自当舍身取义，覆护黎民！
 你犯下过错，不容轻赦，须得依律惩处……”

PunishEvent4_5.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Lion-Face Clan senior who guards here.
The senior exclaims:

"Daring to stir trouble on my Guangdong turf—are you looking down on the brothers of Lion-Face Clan?!
Weak in body, corrupt in heart—looks like you need some proper training in our sect!"
PunishEvent4_5.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至狮相门护卫此地的前辈身前，
便听对方高声道：

 “敢在我广东地界犯事，阁下莫非是瞧不起我狮相门各堂弟兄？！
 身不强，则心不正，就让你在我门中好好操练一番！”

PunishEvent4_6.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Ranshan senior who guards here.
The senior declares:

"The laws of heaven and earth must be upheld.
We seldom interfere with worldly affairs, yet since you have disturbed our Qilu lands,
you cannot be allowed to leave unpunished—prepare to face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_6.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至然山派护卫此地的前辈身前，
便听对方开口道：

 “天地之间，自有法理相循，
 我等虽甚少问及尘世，然你既扰我齐鲁之地，
 便难以轻纵，还请依律受罚……”

PunishEvent4_7.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Jade-Maiden Sect's senior who guards here.
The senior says:

"Our sect does not meddle in worldly affairs lightly,
yet, the people of Jingnan have long been under our care.
Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment..."
PunishEvent4_7.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至璇女派护卫此地的前辈身前，
方听对方开口道：

 “尘世俗务，我等本无意过多牵涉，
然荆南之百姓，素来与我派互有照拂，
 你既犯下过错，须得依律受惩……”

PunishEvent4_8.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the senior of the Swordsmith Villa who guards here.
The senior says:

"Though we forge weapons, we also safeguard this land and its people.
Your wrongdoings cannot go unpunished. You must face judgment. There is nothing more to say..."
PunishEvent4_8.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至铸剑山庄护卫此地的前辈身前，
便听对方开口道：

 “我等虽以铸造宝剑为要，但亦护佑此地百姓安危，
你既已服法，也无须再多言，便请依律受惩……”

PunishEvent4_9.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Kongsang Sect senior who guards here.
The senior declares:

"Though we seek the path to immortality and wish not to be disturbed by trivial matters,
this place is our sanctuary, and we will not allow any disruption..."
PunishEvent4_9.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至空桑派护卫此地的前辈身前，
便听对方朗声道：

 “我等虽一心求取长生之道，不愿为旁杂之事所扰， 
但此地毕竟是我等的安身之处，不容有人打搅……”

PunishEvent4_10.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Vajra senior who guards here.
The senior says in a solemn tone:

"All Western Regions bow to our sect's glory.
Your transgression tarnishes the Buddha's name—you shall be chastised..."
PunishEvent4_10.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至金刚宗驻守此地的前辈身前，
便听对方沉声道：

“西域之地皆供奉我金刚宗，
你在此处犯错，便是坏了佛爷威名，须得惩治一番……”
PunishEvent4_10.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> предстает перед старшим Ваджрой, который охраняет здесь.Старший говорит торжественным тоном: "Все Западные края преклоняются перед славой нашей Секты."Любой твой проступок порочит имя Будды — ты будешь наказан..."

PunishEvent4_11.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Five Immortals Sect senior who guards here.
The senior's voice booms:

"Our Gu have almost starved in their crucibles...
You'll serve as their feeding trough before leaving..."
PunishEvent4_11.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至五仙教驻守此地的前辈身前，
便听对方扬声道：

“寨中的毒蛊虫豸，已炼了许久，正须试验毒性，
你既落在我五仙教手中，便得给你种只蛊儿才能让你离去……”
PunishEvent4_11.ru:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> предстает перед старшим Секты пяти Бессмертных, который охраняет здесь.
 Гремит голос старшего:

 "Наши Гу почти умерли с голоду в своих тиглях..."Ты послужишь им кормушкой перед уходом..."

PunishEvent4_12.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Veil Scar senior who guards here.
The senior's voice echoes:

"The Veil Scar Sect needs no reasons—only obedience.
You are ours to break..."
PunishEvent4_12.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至界青门驻守此地的前辈身前，
便听对方开口道：

“界青门有界青门的规矩，
我界青门要惩治你，你便无须知道其中的缘故……”
PunishEvent4_12.ru:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> предстает перед старшим со шрамом от Вуали, который охраняет здесь.
 Эхом отдается голос старшего:

 "Секта Завесы не нуждается ни в каких причинах — только в повиновении."Ты наш, чтобы сломить..."

PunishEvent4_13.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Fuloong Sanctuary senior who guards here.
The senior's voice echoes through the chamber:

"The Chiming Island's people offer us gold and silver in tribute, blessed under the True Loong's protection.
Yet you dare undermine its divine authority? You shall face severe punishment!"
PunishEvent4_13.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至伏龙坛驻守此地的前辈身前，
便听对方高声道：

“赤明岛内百姓皆向我派供奉金银，便是得了真龙护佑，
你却在此处破坏我等神威，须得严惩！”

PunishEvent4_14.en:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is brought before the Sanguine senior who guards here.
The senior's voice rings out:

"Dare you act with such insolence within the domain of the Sanguine Sect?
Do you not tremble before the wrath of Xiangshu the Great Lord? Should I fail to punish you, it would tarnish the honor of our entire sect..."
PunishEvent4_14.cn:
<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被带至血犼教驻守此地的前辈身前，
便听对方高声道：

“你在我血犼神教的地界上为所欲为，
岂不让相枢大神小瞧了我等，若不将你惩治，有损我教声威……”
